notes: Wallpaper grows up. (1) Kinto now samples the colors of the wallpaper it shows and themes its accents, glow and the Lens from them, with light/dark ink chosen from the wallpaper's real brightness. (2) On foldables the Background card has a Cover screen / Main screen switch - each screen gets its own photo input, its own set-as-wallpaper action and its own saved copy. (3) Six built-in wallpapers, rendered by Kinto itself: Ember Fold, Basalt, Dawn, Deepwater, Ultraviolet, Moss & Slate - tap one to set it for the selected screen, colors sampled automatically.
